title: Education & Bulk Orders
documentTitle: Education, Holiday Gifts & Bulk Orders | SUPUZZ
description: Plan SUPUZZ orders for preschool and Pre-K classrooms, child care programs, holiday gifts and community events. Share your quantities, budget and delivery needs.
intro: More ways to play together. Plan a SUPUZZ order for your classroom, organization or next celebration.

education.title: Preschools & early learning
education.body: For preschool, Pre-K and child care teams planning building centers, small-group play or a classroom refresh.
education.detail: Tell us the children’s ages and how you plan to use the products. Choose each item according to its listed age recommendation.

gifts.title: Holiday gifts & group giving
gifts.body: For holiday gifting, school celebrations, community toy drives and employee family gifts.
gifts.detail: Share the number of recipients, your budget per gift and the event date so we can discuss suitable order options.

request.title: Let’s plan your order
request.intro: Send a few details to get started:

details.organization: School or organization, intended use and children’s ages.
details.products: Products you’re interested in, estimated quantities and budget.
details.delivery: Delivery ZIP code and the date you need the order to arrive.

request.paperwork: Need a formal quote, purchase order review or vendor paperwork? Include your requirements so we can confirm what we can support.
request.next: Our team will confirm availability, pricing, shipping and timing with you before you order.
